findings: An org CANNOT be walked from nothing to invoiceable without hand-editing the database: setting the flat-fee agreement has no write surface. agreements.ts exports three functions and all three read; no application file calls agreement.create
Kennitala capture already existed end to end — column, input schema, repository and routes. The dispatch's premise that nothing captures it needed correcting; no migration was required
What was actually missing was validation: the field carried /^\d{6}-?\d{4}$/ and nothing else, accepting any ten digits, so a transposed pair was stored silently

Charger attach finding 3a: orgId comes from the request body and is never checked against the caller — but requirePermission(charger.write) has no orgIdParam so the route is platform-staff-only. NOT a tenant escalation; an operator-error surface

Charger attach finding 3b, which lands on money: ocppIdentities is unique on (orgId, identityString) not identityString, createCharger does no existence check, and the gateway auth lookup is WHERE lower(identity_string)=lower($1) LIMIT 1 with no org scope and no ORDER BY. Duplicated identities route a charger's energy to an arbitrary org. Trigger is an ordinary business event — a charger moving between orgs

All three 2026-08-08 invite defects verified FIXED: the bearer-only hijack (ADR 0053), the invitee lockout (claim-then-redeem via POST /api/driver/claim-invite), and the missing idToken (createDriver inserts a virtual_rfid)

kennitala is returned by the cross-tenant org LIST endpoint, because toSummary is shared by listOrgs and getOrgById. Not an open leak — the route carries platform.tenant.read — but an over-broad payload behind a correct guard

WinAnsiEncoding is not Latin-1: the header's en dash would have been written as byte 0x13, a device control, in every PDF. Caught by generating the golden file and reading it

very_tldr: An org cannot be walked from nothing to invoiceable without hand-editing the database: four of five steps have an API surface, but setting the flat-fee agreement has none — agreements.ts is read-only and nothing calls agreement.create. Kennitala capture already existed; the real gap was validation, since the field accepted any ten digits and stored a transposed pair silently. Two charger findings, one of which routes a charger's energy to an arbitrary org because identities are unique per (orgId, identityString) while the auth lookup is an unscoped LIMIT 1 with no ORDER BY. All three 2026-08-08 invite defects are fixed, so task 13's BLOCKER should be lifted and restated. 21 of 21 gates, 7 of 7 fallback items, npm run check 14 green, 992 + 176 tests.
